title: II Samuel 24
summary: In the way - Which seems added, to shew, how little the example of parents, or ancestors, is to be valued where it is opposed to the will and word of God.

inlines.v: In the way - Which seems added, to shew, how little the example of parents, or ancestors, is to be valued where it is opposed to the will and word of God.
His father, &c. - Most unhappy parents, that thus help to damn their own children's souls!
